Exam Type: MRI KNEE LEFT WO CONTRAST
Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: Left knee pain for 2 weeks. No known cause.
Comparison: Left knee radiograph dated [DATE]

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the left knee was performed on a 1.5 Tesla system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Alignment is anatomic. No acute fracture or bone bruise. Background marrow signal is normal without infiltrative marrow process. No aggressive osseous lesions. Large T1/T2 hypointense, cortically based lesion along the distal medial femoral diaphysis with a slightly broader zone of transition in expected, likely represents an old nonossifying fibroma.

JOINT SPACE:
Large joint effusion with increased T1 signal compatible with hemarthrosis, with extensive synovial proliferation, including more focal focal synovitis at the posterosuperior joint space. No intra-articular bodies. No Baker's cyst.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Medial compartment cartilage: Cartilage thinning, heterogeneity, and fissuring along weightbearing medial femoral condyle tibial plateau.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Lateral compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: High grade partial thickness cartilage loss along the medial patellar facet with focal high grade fissuring.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Normal.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Normal.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: Mild distal quadriceps insertional tendinosis. No tendon tear.
Patella tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.
Patellofemoral tracking: No edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. No lateral patellar tilt or translation. No patella alta. Normal patellar and trochlear morphology. Normal tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance measuring 15 mm.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

IMPRESSION:
1.	Sclerotic cortically based lesion along the distal medial femoral diaphysis, likely representing a healed (ossified) nonossifying fibroma. Follow-up radiographs in 3 months recommended to demonstrate stability.
2.	Large knee joint hemarthrosis with extensive synovitis. Given no significant traumatic injury, differential considerations includes pigmented villonodular synovitis (PVNS), coagulopathy, infectious/inflammatory etiologies such as an inflammatory arthropathy or Lyme' s disease.
3.	Medial and patellofemoral compartment chondrosis, as described above.

Stigmata der medial betonten Pangonarthrose mit osteophytären Anbauten an den Femurkondylen bds., Knochenmarksödem in der medialen Femurkondyle und proximalen, medialen Tibia sowie Ausbildung subchondraler Zysten im medialen Tibiaplateau mit einer Ausdehnung von bis zu 5 x 5 mm (5/17). Knochenmarksödem auch in der dorsolateralen Femurkondyle (5/27) bei hier fokal tiefergreifender Chondropathie (4/11). Ansonsten in den vorliegenden Sequenzen unauffällige Signalgebung der ossären Strukturen. Höhergradig geminderter Knorpelbesatz am proximalen Tibiaplateau mit fokal vollschichtige Chondropathie über eine Ausdehnung von 9 x 19 mm (a.p. x ml, 6/8 sowie 5/20); flächig vollschichtige Chondropathie auch an der medialen Femurkondyle nach medial hin. Keine höhergradige Chondropathie im lateralen Kompartiment. Retropatellar geminderter Knorpelbesatz mit betont an der medialen Trochleafacette höhergradiger Chondropathie ohne fokal vollschichtigen chondralen Defekt. Ausgeprägter Substanzdefekt des Innenmeniskus in der Pars intermedia und im Hinterhorn mit aufgefaserter Struktur sowie radiärem Defekt am Hinterhorn (5/25). Kein Anhalt für eine Rissbildung des Außenmeniskus. VKB sowie HKB intakt. Geringer medialer Reizzustand. LCL mit intakter Signalgebung. Kein Kniegelenkserguss. Kleine, gering flüssigkeitsgefüllte Baker-Zyste. Fabella. 2 Chondrome dorsal. Quadriceps- sowie Patellarsehne mit intakter Signalgebung. Unauffällige Signalgebung der übrigen miterfassten Weichteile in den vorliegenden Sequenzen.

COMPARISON:None.

CLINICAL HISTORY:Traumatic fall 5 months prior. Plain films from mild osteoarthritis, assess for ligamentous/meniscal tear left knee.

PROCEDURE:Multisequence, multiplanar unenhanced MRI of the left knee according to routine protocol.

IMAGING FINDINGS:

Nondiagnostic scout localizing images reviewed.

The medial meniscus shows intrasubstance degeneration in the posterior horn and body, without evidence of underlying tear. The lateral meniscus is intact.

Intact anterior cruciate ligament and posterior cruciate ligament.

Medial collateral ligament and posterior oblique ligament are intact. The fibular collateral ligament is intact. Popliteus and biceps femoris tendon attachments are intact. Iliotibial band is intact.

The patellar retinacula are intact. No femoral trochlear dysplasia. The TT-TG distance measures 4 mm, within normal limits. Mild quadriceps insertional tendinosis without tear. Mild proximal patellar tendinosis without tear.

Preserved patellofemoral articular cartilage. There is fissuring of articular cartilage throughout the medial femorotibial compartment, bone weightbearing aspect. Preserved lateral femorotibial articular cartilage.

Small knee joint effusion. Tiny Baker's cyst. Regional musculature is within normal limits. No suspicious focal marrow signal alteration. 

IMPRESSION:
1. Mild quadriceps and patellar tendinosis without tear. No evidence of discrete meniscal, ligament, or tendon tear.
2. Mild to moderate medial femorotibial chondrosis suggesting evolving mild medial compartment osteoarthritis left knee.

Exam Type: MRI KNEE RIGHT WO CONTRAST
Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: Pain.
Comparison: No relevant prior studies available for comparison.

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the right knee was performed on a 1.5 Tesla system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Mild bone marrow edema and cystic changes are present at the tibial spines and at the lateral femoral condyle centrally bordering on the intercondylar notch.. No acute fracture or bone bruise. Background marrow signal is normal without infiltrative marrow process. No aggressive osseous lesions.

JOINT SPACE:
Small joint effusion. Mild, diffuse synovial proliferation. Moderate Baker cyst.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: There is a complex tear involving the posterior horn and body, with a large radial tear at the posterior root attachment. Moderate extrusion.
Medial compartment cartilage: There is mild to moderate cartilage thinning and surface irregularity diffusely. Small osteophytes.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: There is a complex tear involving the anterior and posterior root attachments. Fraying of the inner margin diffusely. No extrusion.
Lateral compartment cartilage: There is mild cartilage thinning at the posterior aspect, with cartilage fissuring centrally near the intercondylar notch.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: There is mild to moderate cartilage thinning and fissuring at the patella, medial greater than lateral. Trochlear cartilage appears intact.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): There is mucoid degeneration of the anterior cruciate ligament, which otherwise appears intact.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Degenerated, intact.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Normal.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Patella tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.
Patellofemoral tracking: No edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. No lateral patellar tilt or translation. No patella alta. Normal patellar and trochlear morphology. Normal tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance measuring 6 mm.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

IMPRESSION:


1. Medial and lateral meniscal tear. Medial meniscal extrusion.

2. Tricompartmental chondrosis.

3. Mucoid degeneration of the anterior cruciate ligament.

4. Small joint effusion with synovial proliferation. Moderate Baker cyst.
